entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Measuring rods and tapes and divided scales
entries.comment:
This reduced rate applies only to aids for the deaf, blind and visually impaired persons (part 3):
— Measuring instruments with sound output or special marking, including measuring tapes, levels and other such items; 9017 80 10,  9017 80 90, 9031
—thermometers with sound output ; 9025 19 00 — barometers with sound output; 9025 80 20 — calculators with sound output; 9017 20 90, 8470
